name: HebrewCore API
description:
HebrewCore by [baba Hebrew](https://itsbaba.com) is the language layer for products that work in Hebrew. One REST API for:

- **Translation** between Hebrew, English, Russian and more, with RTL/LTR metadata on both sides.
- **Protected translation** that keeps prices, quantities, dates, codes, product names and interface variables exactly as written, and verifies every sentence.
- **Account terms**: a list of names (drugs, products, brands) kept exactly in every protected translation.
- **Render-ready display** of mixed Hebrew and English lines, and **language detection** for code-switched input.
- **Transliteration** and **nikud** (vowel points) for display and speech.
- The **Clinical API** for health products: verified clinical translation, streaming, record-search queries and verification.

## Quick start

1. [Sign up free](https://hc.itsbaba.com/console), save a card (no charge on the Free plan), and create an API key.
2. Send it as a bearer token.
3. Call an endpoint:

```bash
curl https://hc.itsbaba.com/v1/translate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer hc_live_YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "text": "Welcome to your account", "target_lang": "he" }'
```

## Authentication

Every endpoint except `GET /v1/health` needs `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Keys are `hc_live_…` (production) or `hc_test_…` (sandbox), are shown once, and are stored only as a hash. Use them from your server only. TLS 1.2 or newer.

## Limits

| Limit | Default |
|---|---|
| Requests | 600 per minute per account, across all its keys, on every plan. `429 rate_limited` with `Retry-After`. |
| Characters | Monthly characters set by your [plan](/pricing). Protected balanced counts 2×, nikud and the Clinical API 3×, smartest up to 5×; direction, detection and wrap are free. `429 quota_exceeded`. |
| Request size | 20,000 characters (5,000 for transliterate, 10,000 for nikud). |

Responses carry `X-Usage-Chars-Used`, `X-Usage-Chars-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-Content-Stored` and `Server-Timing`. Errors use one envelope: `{ "error": { "type", "message", "code" } }`.

## Docs for people and for AI

- [Documentation](https://hc.itsbaba.com/docs) with guides
- [docs.md](https://hc.itsbaba.com/docs.md): the whole documentation as Markdown
- [llms.txt](https://hc.itsbaba.com/llms.txt) and [llms-full.txt](https://hc.itsbaba.com/llms-full.txt): an index and the complete docs plus this reference, for language models
- [openapi.json](https://hc.itsbaba.com/openapi.json): this spec
- [API catalog](https://hc.itsbaba.com/.well-known/api-catalog) (RFC 9727) and [apis.json](https://hc.itsbaba.com/apis.json): machine-readable discovery
